entities.name: Lydia Valentín
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Lydia Valentín Pérez is a Spanish retired weightlifter, Olympic Champion, 2 time World Champion and 4 time European Champion competing in the 75 kg category until 2018 and 81 kg starting in 2018 after the International Weightlifting Federation reorganized the categories. Lydia has won three Olympic medals, two World Weightlifting Championships, as well as four European Weightlifting Championships.
